comments.author: Participant A
comments.body: We need to ensure there is documentation for syncing all of PyPI - it will take a long time at first sync, but it is doable. It's the default behavior, so users will try it.

comments.author: Participant A
comments.body:
The Python plugin also removed the necessity for creating publications - Katello could benefit from dropping Python as a "publication type".  Users syncing all of PyPI should see a nice sync performance improvement. The cost will be that the metadata needs to be generated when content is pulled.
Edit: this is done.
